stage_probe.scope: Headless, existing WEVA_STAGE_LOG and WEVA_CASCADE_LOG enabled; phase timings instrumented, not production timing estimates.
stage_probe.script:
extends Node
func _ready() -> void:
	for kind in ["field_paint", "parent_paint", "parent_layout"]:
		var doc := WevaDocument.new()
		doc.paused = true
		doc.interactive = false
		var markup := "<form id=f>"
		for i in range(48): markup += '<label>Setting<input id=n%d type=number min=1 max=10 value=5></label>' % i
		doc.html = markup + "</form>"
		doc.css = 'form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,240px);width:1000px}input{display:block;width:180px;height:20px}'
		if kind == "field_paint": doc.css += 'input:out-of-range{background-color:red}'
		if kind == "parent_paint": doc.css += 'form:has(:out-of-range){background-color:red}'
		if kind == "parent_layout": doc.css += 'form:has(:out-of-range){width:1020px}'
		add_child(doc)
		doc.update_document(0)
		for value in ["6", "11", "5"]:
			print("PROBE_START ", kind, " ", value)
			doc.set_element_value("#n0", value)
			doc.update_document(0)
			print("PROBE_END")
		doc.free()
	get_tree().quit()
